race.comment: TWO UP BOOM (5) flew home last start when the race favourite, ending up 0.7L off the winner when back to 1100m. Now out to 1300m which looks a good move and Pike hops in the saddle for the first time this campaign. Maps to be closer in the run this time and he can land the knockout blow. SWEET ISSY (9) gets the blinkers on for the first time today after a 0.6L defeat at Pinjarra to end last campaign. The wide draw is a query, but she showed good ability at the end of last campaign and she can return with a bang. ABOUT TURN (2) resumed in good order last campaign in similar circumstances. Tsang was on board for his recent trial and sticks today, with his early speed important from a tricky gate. Can make an impression. SQUEALER (13) won her latest trial coming into this and won't be far away. ENERGETIC (1) is not to be discounted from a better draw today.
